title: TOEIC Writing Q6-7: Customer Service
description: Email chăm sóc khách hàng: đổi trả, gói du lịch, phàn nàn dịch vụ.

prompts.title: Product return

email.subject: Product return
body: I recently purchased a battery for my camera from your Web site.
The online description said that the battery would be compatible with my camera, but it's the wrong size.
What do I need to do to return this battery and get the right one for my camera?
translationVi: Gần đây tôi mua pin máy ảnh trên trang web của quý công ty.
Mô tả trực tuyến nói pin này tương thích với máy ảnh của tôi, nhưng kích cỡ lại không đúng.
Tôi cần làm gì để trả lại pin này và nhận đúng loại pin cho máy ảnh của tôi?

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a customer service representative. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and ask ONE question.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là nhân viên chăm sóc khách hàng của Glenn Cameras.

tasks.label: Information 1
tasks.requirement: Explain that there should be a return label.
tasks.example: There should be a return label inside the package you received.

tasks.label: Question
tasks.requirement: Ask for one detail needed to process the return.
tasks.example: Can you send me your order number?

tasks.label: Information 2
tasks.requirement: Explain what will happen after receiving the product.
tasks.example: Once I receive it, I will send the correct battery to you.

vocabulary.example: The customer service department will contact you today.
You can send the product back in any box.
This battery is compatible with your camera.
We should reduce the wait time for customers.

patterns: Once I receive it, I will ...
sampleAnswer: Hello, Robert,
I apologize for the confusion.
There should be a return label inside the package you received.
Can you send me your order number?
Once I receive the battery, I will send the correct one to you.
Thank you,
Glenn Cameras

sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Tôi xin lỗi về sự nhầm lẫn này.

sampleBlanks.sentence: There should be a _____ inside the package.
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Nên có nhãn trả hàng trong gói hàng.
Bạn có thể gửi cho tôi mã đơn hàng không?

prompts.title: Vacation package

email.subject: A great vacation package
body: We are offering an unbelievable opportunity for you to explore the Galapagos Islands.
The first 200 customers who respond to this advertisement will receive a 10% discount on their hotel fares.
translationVi: Chúng tôi đang cung cấp một cơ hội tuyệt vời để quý khách khám phá quần đảo Galapagos.
200 khách hàng đầu tiên phản hồi quảng cáo này sẽ được giảm 10% giá khách sạn.

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a Passageways Travel customer. In your e-mail, ask TWO questions and make ONE request regarding the travel package.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là khách hàng quan tâm đến gói du lịch.

tasks.label: Question 1
tasks.requirement: Ask one question about the length of the trip.
tasks.example: How many days does the tour last?

tasks.label: Question 2
tasks.requirement: Ask one question about family options.

tasks.label: Request
tasks.requirement: Request more information about the package.
tasks.example: Could you please send me more information about this package?

vocabulary.example: I am interested in your sightseeing tours.

vocabulary.meaningVi: được dẫn bởi hướng dẫn viên giàu kinh nghiệm
vocabulary.example: All tours are led by experienced guides.
I have a complaint about the hotel service.
You could offer a coupon for our next trip.
I am interested in the travel package.

sampleAnswer: Dear Mr. Contos,
I am very interested in the travel package to the Galapagos Islands.
How many days does the tour last?
Also, are there discounts for children?
Could you please send me more information about this package as soon as possible?
Thank you,
Pamela Frederickson

sampleBlanks.sentence: I am very _____ in the travel package.
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Tôi rất quan tâm đến gói du lịch.

sampleBlanks.sentence: How many days does the tour _____?
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Chuyến tham quan kéo dài bao nhiêu ngày?

sampleBlanks.sentence: Could you please send me more _____?
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Bạn có thể gửi thêm thông tin cho tôi không?

guidedOutline.opening: I am very interested in the travel package to the Galapagos Islands.

prompts.title: Travel complaint

email.subject: About your complaint
body: My manager tells me you experienced some problems with our service during your recent trip to Malaysia.
Please tell us what happened to you and how we can make you satisfied with our company.
translationVi: Quản lý của tôi cho biết cô đã gặp một số vấn đề với dịch vụ của chúng tôi trong chuyến đi Malaysia gần đây.
Vui lòng cho chúng tôi biết chuyện gì đã xảy ra và chúng tôi có thể làm gì để khiến cô hài lòng.

prompts.directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are Marilyn McMillan. In your e-mail, describe TWO problems and suggest ONE way the travel company can make you more satisfied.
prompts.roleVi: Bạn là Marilyn McMillan, khách hàng đã phàn nàn về chuyến du lịch.

tasks.label: Problem 1
tasks.requirement: Describe one problem from the trip.
tasks.example: The hotel room did not have an ocean view.

tasks.label: Problem 2
tasks.requirement: Describe a second problem from the trip.
tasks.example: Breakfast was not included every day.

tasks.label: Suggestion
tasks.requirement: Suggest one way to make you satisfied.
tasks.example: Please offer a coupon for our next trip.

vocabulary.example: I am interested in your sightseeing tours.

vocabulary.meaningVi: được dẫn bởi hướng dẫn viên giàu kinh nghiệm
vocabulary.example: All tours are led by experienced guides.
I have a complaint about the hotel service.
You could offer a coupon for our next trip.

patterns: If you want to make us happy customers again, ...
sampleAnswer: Dear Paradise Travel,
Thank you for asking about my complaint.
The first problem was that our hotel room did not have an ocean view.
The other problem was that breakfast was not included every day.
If you want to make us happy customers again, please offer a coupon for our next trip.
Marilyn McMillan

sampleBlanks.sentence: The first problem was that our room did not have _____.
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Vấn đề đầu tiên là phòng không có tầm nhìn ra biển.

sampleBlanks.sentence: The other problem was that breakfast was not _____.
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Vấn đề còn lại là bữa sáng không được bao gồm mỗi ngày.

sampleBlanks.sentence: Please offer a _____ for our next trip.
sampleBlanks.meaningVi: Vui lòng tặng phiếu giảm giá cho chuyến đi tiếp theo.

guidedOutline.opening: Thank you for asking about my complaint.
